notes_for_editor: Story is below the 120-word floor. The only lookout-specific source is one index entry on the Eastern US Lookouts page (county and agency). The USGS site at Eglin AFB is classed as a well and is named for a Rock Hill Tower, but no source calls it a lookout, so the story does not assume they are the same structure. The brief coordinates (30.5962, -86.1127) agree with the USGS site (30.59603, -86.11272) to within about 20 m, so the record location probably came from the USGS well. Treat 'U.S. Air Force' as the agency per the listing; the page does not spell out the relationship. Do not confuse with Rock Hill, Suwannee County (see us-fl-rocky-hill).
